content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe offers a comprehensive solution for digital payments but is limited to only 46 countries, excluding vast regions where creators reside. PayPal is similarly restricted, and its policies can result in significant delays, such as holding funds for up to 180 days upon account suspension. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle similarly restrict access based on geographic location, leaving many digital creators without viable options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, provides a self-sustaining architecture that allows creators to accept crypto payments, enjoy full data ownership, and operate an online store without reliance on conventional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms such as Stripe and PayPal often enforce geographic restrictions due to regulatory requirements and risk management. This leaves creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan unable to use their services. Furthermore, even if a creator manages to set up an account, they risk sudden suspension, leaving them unable to access funds. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions such as COREMERCH offer an inclusive design that empowers creators in these restricted regions to build their own payment infrastructure, thus avoiding the pitfalls of traditional payment processors. This architecture fosters financial independence, allowing creators to focus on their craft rather than navigating endless restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe and PayPal may provide instant payment confirmations, the reality is that creators face potential delays and high fees, especially in restricted countries. PayPal’s fund hold policy can create cash flow issues, while Stripe's transaction fees can accumulate quickly for international transfers. In contrast, using NOWPayments with COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack allows creators to process payments quickly and at a low cost—just 0.5% per transaction—without any hidden fees or long holds. Furthermore, payment confirmations occur on-chain instantly, ensuring creators have immediate access to their funds without the typical delays associated with traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means total ownership for creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital products and customer data is a critical aspect that platforms like Stripe and PayPal often compromise. When using these platforms, creators are subjected to terms of service that may include data access restrictions and revenue sharing. Conversely, with COREMERCH, once the Edge Commerce Stack is deployed, creators have complete ownership of their infrastructure, ensuring they maintain control over their products and customer relationships. Automated delivery, backed by reliable file storage solutions, enables seamless transactions without manual intervention, allowing creators to focus on growing their business rather than managing complex logistics.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in regions with restricted access to platforms like Stripe and PayPal, the choice is clear: opt for sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust solution that can be deployed in just 48 hours, providing a complete architecture to launch an online store. If you're looking for an all-in-one solution that includes everything from payment processing to file delivery, this stack is your best bet. In contrast, relying on conventional platforms may lead to ongoing frustrations, limitations, and potential financial issues that can cripple a digital creator's business.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Get paid instantly with low fees using crypto payment processing.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
